fullPassage: We have a 'diving reflex', like other marine mammals. This means that special nerve endings on our faces, around the mouth and nose, trigger this reflex only when the facial region goes under water. If we are in the water, with our head out in the air, there is no diving reflex. But if we sink just our face in a bowl of water, while the whole of the rest of our body is in the dry air, the diving reflex is triggered. It automatically closes down the airway, reducing the risk of swallowing water, and it narrows the small air-passages in the lungs. At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them from the effects of the brief stop in breathing. By contrast, if a chimpanzee or a gorilla found itself in water with its face below the surface, it would panic, its heart would race and it would quickly drown.

❌ ③ (A) 빠르게 뛰다 — (B) 인종: (B)는 100미터 '경주'이지 인종이 아님
✅ ④ (A) 빠르게 뛰다 — (B) 경주: (A)는 심장이 '빠르게 뛰다', (B)는 100미터 '경주'로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
det.tip: race: ① (동사) (심장이) 빠르게 뛰다 ② (명사) 경주 ③ (명사) 인종 ④ (동사) 질주하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to die because you are under water and cannot breathe"

det.korean: drown=익사하다 — 물속에서 숨을 쉴 수 없어 죽다
det.analysis:
✅ ① drown: drown(익사하다)은 물속에서 숨을 못 쉬어 죽는다는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② panic: panic(당황하다)은 죽음이 아닌 심리 상태
❌ ③ trigger: trigger(유발하다)는 익사와 무관
❌ ④ swallow: swallow(삼키다)는 익사가 아닌 삼키는 행위
det.tip: drown = 익사하다. die under water and cannot breathe가 핵심

questions.passage: It automatically closes down the airway, __________ (reduction) the risk of swallowing water, and it narrows the small air-passages in the lungs. At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them from the effects of the brief stop in breathing.

det.analysis: 앞 절의 결과·부연을 나타내는 분사구문 자리이므로 명사 reduction을 현재분사 reducing으로 변환. '~을 줄이면서'의 의미. closes down the airway, reducing the risk ~
det.tip: 분사구문 V-ing: ~, reducing the risk(위험을 줄이면서)

questions.passage: At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them from the effects of the brief stop in breathing. By contrast, if a chimpanzee found itself in water with its face below the surface, it would panic and it would quickly __________ (drowning).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 조동사 would 뒤에 동사원형 — drowning → drown
det.analysis: 조동사 would 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 한다. it would quickly drown. 현재분사형 drowning을 동사원형 drown으로 변환
det.tip: 조동사 would + 동사원형: would quickly drown

questions.passage: We have a 'diving reflex', like other marine mammals. This means that special nerve endings on our faces, around the mouth and nose, trigger this reflex only when the facial region __________. If we are in the water, with our head out in the air, there is no diving reflex. But if we sink just our face in a bowl of water, while the whole of the rest of our body is in the dry air, the diving reflex is triggered. It automatically closes down the airway, reducing the risk of swallowing water, and it narrows the small air-passages in the lungs. At the same time the heart rate is slowed down to half speed and blood is shunted to the vital organs, protecting them from the effects of the brief stop in breathing. By contrast, if a chimpanzee or a gorilla found itself in water with its face below the surface, it would panic, its heart would race and it would quickly drown.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: goes under water=물속으로 들어가다 — 얼굴 부위가 물에 들어갈 때만 반사가 유발됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① is exposed to bright light(밝은 빛에 노출되다): 반사는 빛이 아닌 물에 의해 유발됨
❌ ② touches another person(다른 사람과 닿다): 본문과 무관
✅ ③ goes under water: 원문 일치. 얼굴 부위가 물속으로 들어갈(goes under water) 때만 반사가 유발된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ becomes very cold(매우 차가워지다): 본문은 온도가 아닌 물 접촉을 언급
det.tip: trigger this reflex only when the facial region goes under water — 물에 들어갈 때

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: shunted to the vital organs=중요 장기로 보내지다 — 혈액이 생명 장기로 돌려져 보호됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① removed from the body completely(몸에서 완전히 제거되다): 혈액이 제거되면 보호가 불가능해 모순
✅ ② shunted to the vital organs: 원문 일치. 혈액이 중요 장기로 보내져(shunted) 호흡 정지의 영향으로부터 보호한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ replaced with fresh oxygen(신선한 산소로 교체되다): 본문에 혈액 교체 언급 없음
❌ ④ stored only in the lungs(폐에만 저장되다): 본문은 중요 장기로의 이동을 설명
det.tip: blood is shunted to the vital organs — 혈액이 중요 장기로 보내진다
